# Build System and Package Structure

The build page explains how the repository is packaged, built, exported, and prepared for local development or distribution.
## Purpose and Scope
This area explains how the repository is built, packaged, and exposed to consumers. It covers scripts, config files, package entrypoints, and the delivery shape readers need before they publish or self-host the project.
## What Lives Here
- `apps/web/next.config.ts` - Build or framework configuration that shapes the generated app, package output, or developer workflow.
- `apps/web/package.json` - Repository file related to this page.
- `apps/web/postcss.config.mjs` - Build or framework configuration that shapes the generated app, package output, or developer workflow.
- `package.json` - Package manifest that defines scripts, entrypoints, exports, and dependency boundaries.
- `packages/better-cmdk/package.json` - Repository file related to this page.
## Build Inputs
- `build` runs `turbo run build` and creates the production build or compiled package artifacts.
- `dev` runs `turbo run dev` and starts the local development workflow.
- `typecheck` runs `turbo run typecheck` and supports the project workflow.
